prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent RGBA sprite atlas for the UNDERSTAR Phaser game, 1536 x 1024 canvas.
Primary request: High quality baked game artwork for a calm town-bed save guidance arrow, matching a painterly fantasy mining game with carved slate, worn warm brass, midnight teal fabric, tiny amber Ember inlays, beveled edges and crisp detailed material lighting.
Composition: exactly THREE separate assets with ample genuinely transparent empty gutters, no background, no checkerboard pixels, no bounding boxes. Keep each asset wholly inside its specified region.
1. Upper left region x=0..768,y=0..640: a circular brass and dark teal enamel medallion centered at (384,320), diameter approximately 450px. Inside is a beautifully readable side-view carved oak BED with ivory pillow and quilted midnight teal blanket, a small amber crescent above it. Quiet safe restful mood; no letters.
2. Upper right region x=768..1536,y=0..640: a single substantial DOWNWARD pointing arrow centered (1152,320), overall width approximately 250px, height 520px, narrow slate shaft and broad pointed head, beveled warm brass edging, amber glowing inlaid seam, midnight teal stone face. Match the dimensional worn brass/slate of the game's ornate tutorial pointer. No medallion or letters in this arrow; this sprite rotates independently.
3. Bottom region x=0..1536,y=640..1024: one horizontal ornate slate and brass instruction plaque centered (768,832), approximately 1430px wide and 250px tall. Crisp engraved ivory and pale gold serif lettering across exactly TWO centered lines. First line exactly "RETURN TO YOUR TOWN BED". Second line exactly "SLEEP TO SAVE". The lettering is part of the painted plaque. Readable at 500px display width. Subtle brass filigree, dark teal slate center, small warm amber corner gems, modest relief shadow within transparent silhouette.
Lighting/mood: warm restrained top-left highlights, rich dark materials, tranquil handcrafted fantasy game library quality, strong clean silhouettes.
Constraints: real alpha transparency around every asset and through empty gutters; all three assets separate for runtime cropping; no other objects; no watermark; no HTML look, flat vector shapes, emoji, excessive particle bloom, blurry edges, extra text, pictograms unrelated to bed. Do not write region labels or atlas guides.

Use case: background-extraction. Edit the provided sprite atlas only to remove the entire brown/gold/black background into actual PNG alpha transparency. Keep every painted pixel INSIDE the three object silhouettes, including their dark teal fills, bed detail, amber gems, gold bevels and both text lines exactly unchanged. Keep the exact 1536x1024 canvas and exact placement, size and shape of the separate medallion at upper left, arrow at upper right, and instruction plaque at bottom. Hard requirement: the empty corners, all gaps between these three separate objects, and all exterior drop shadow/glow must become completely transparent alpha=0, not black, not checkerboard pixels. Clean antialiased silhouette edges; no glow spill. Return only the three perfectly cut out separated existing assets in RGBA PNG. Do not re-render, move, resize, redraw, add text, or alter the illustration.
presentation: Original RGB artwork is preserved byte-for-byte. Phaser clips each frame to its measured silhouette, following BakedSaveMenuView. The generated checkerboard is outside those silhouettes.
